title: Qwen Partners with Quark Cloud Disk: Organize and Retrieve Documents and Photos, Which Can Be Turned into Posters in a Flash
excerpt: Alibaba's Qwen App has deepened its integration with the Quark Cloud Drive. After authorizing within Qwen, users can directly search, organize, and read files i
content_html:
Alibaba's Qwen App has deepened its integration with the Quark Cloud Drive. After authorizing within Qwen, users can directly search, organize, and read files in the cloud drive within conversations, and generate learning tools, work documents, and interactive web pages based on them.

According to official information, by @ing Quark Cloud Drive on the Qwen homepage, you can call up the Quark Agent's skills to "handle" the cloud drive data. For example, if you forget where a certain file is, just describe what you're looking for in simple language, and Qwen will search for it for you. If you want to do more complex tasks, you can also enable the "Quark Cloud Drive Management" skill in the work assistant and continue working based on the data in the cloud drive.

Photos Become Materials, Data Accumulates into a Shared Knowledge Base

Photos in the cloud drive are no longer just stored for viewing. For example, if you took many scenic photos during a trip to Hangzhou and want to create a commemorative poster, just tell Qwen which photos to use and your preferred style, and it will find the corresponding images and complete the creation.

On the other hand, whether it's external materials you've collected or new content generated from conversations, they can be sent back to Quark Cloud Drive through Qwen, and a shareable link can be generated at the same time, gradually accumulating into a shared knowledge base that can be accessed anytime and updated in real-time. For example, when preparing for an exam, let Qwen create a study plan based on the course notes in the cloud drive, pull up a progress board, and then save it back to the cloud drive and generate a shareable link to send to peers. The entire process can be completed within a single entry point.

For Alibaba, this is equivalent to merging the "conversation interface" and "personal cloud storage" into one: Qwen is responsible for understanding and executing, while Quark Cloud Drive acts as a memory and distribution hub, allowing originally scattered and dormant data to truly flow and be reused, rather than quietly sitting in folders waiting to gather dust. For users who use both Qwen and Quark, fewer app switches and more places to store data indeed improve the experience.
